在我们对[FROM.GetName]发起进攻后，[root.GetTitle][root.GetName]离开了我们的国境。[root.GetHeSheCap]记录下了一段[root.GetHisHer]离开时的信息。

“你最近对灵督城邦的袭击不合情理。无论以何种身份，继续留在你的领土内工作，在道德和伦理上都站不住脚。我强烈建议你们停止这种毫无意义的敌对行动——但是，无论你们将来作何选择，我都不会留在这里坐以待毙了。”

由于[root.GetHisHer]曾在内阁任职，[root.GetName]和[root.GetHisHer]雇员们的离开对政府运作造成了很大的干扰。
texts.en:
Following our attack on the [FROM.GetName], [root.GetTitle] [root.GetName] has left our borders. [root.GetHeSheCap] recorded a message upon [root.GetHisHer] departure.

"Your recent attack upon a Mindwarden Enclave is unconscionable. Working within your territory, in any capacity, would be morally and ethically indefensible. I strongly recommend that you desist from these senseless hostilities - but, whatever your future choices, I shall not stay here to enable them."

Due to [root.GetHisHer] involvement on the Council, the departure of [root.GetName] and [root.GetHisHer] staffers has caused major disruptions to government operations.

你好。我谨代表[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]与你通话。

我们最初对与你们“物现引擎”有关的消息感到担忧。然而，经过进一步的分析，我们认为这种装置是在对所谓“虚境”的非灵能开发方面颇具潜力的新发展。

我们鼓励你们继续部署这项技术，并期待在未来一同合作。
texts.en:
Greetings. I speak to you as a representative of the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName].

We were initially concerned by reports of your 'Materiality Engines'. However, upon further analysis, we consider these devices to be a promising development for non-psionic exploitation of the so-called 'Shroud'.

We encourage your continued deployment of this technology, and look forward to working with you in the future.

label.en: Acknowledged.

texts.zh: 我们对[mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName]恒星系的进攻成功了；[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]现已不复存在。尽管他们所鄙夷的东西对我们毫无意义，但他们对“虚境”的十字军式的讨伐代表了一种不应该在我们星系中存在的伪科学教条主义。
texts.en: Our offensive in the [mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName] system was successful; the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] is no more. Though the practices they despised were of little importance to us, their crusade against the 'Shroud' represented the kind of pseudoscientific dogmatism that should have no place in our galaxy.

texts.zh: 我们的胜利是巨大的成功，甚至还可以从他们空间站的残骸打捞大量的资源。

严峻的时刻到了。尽管我们竭尽全力，轮回之终末还是到来了。它在群星之间四处恐怖地显灵……

These are grave times. Despite our efforts, the End of the Cycle is upon us. Its dreadful manifestation stalks among the stars...

Now is the time for us to stand together and prevent a psionic apocalypse.

你好。我谨代表[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]与你通话。

我们的使命是保护大家免受虚境以及所有传播其恶意效应者的威胁。我们信仰心灵神圣不可侵犯，巩固星系抵御灵能。

我们根据灵能传感器读数判断出你们不会造成这种威胁。太好了。我们很乐意提供帮助，保护你不受伤害。

如果你需要反灵能军事服务，或有多余的泽珞需要处置，可以尽管来找我们。
texts.en:
Greetings. I speak to you as a representative of the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName].

Our mission is to protect against the menace of the Shroud and all those who spread its ill effects. We believe in minds free from invasion, and a galaxy fortified against psionics.

Judging by our psi-sensor readings, you do not contribute to these threats. Excellent. We would be pleased to help you protect against anyone that does.

If you need anti-psionic military services, or have zro to dispose of, let us assist you.

texts.zh:
欢迎回来。[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]很重视我们的持续合作。

我们的灵能传感器读数清晰。你们没有被虚境玷污。很好，很好……

如果你需要反灵能军事服务，或有多余的泽珞需要处置，可以尽管来找我们。
texts.en:
Welcome back. The [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] value our continued cooperation.

Our psi-sensor readings are clear. You remain unsullied by the Shroud. Good, good...

If you need anti-psionic military services, or have zro to dispose of, let us assist you.

label.en: What is the Shroud?

responses.zh:
虚境可以说是一种存在于普通感知之外的维度现实。它完全由有害的“灵能”能量组成。它触及我们物质星系的每一个部分，然而多数人无法主动感知到它。

虚境的能量可以通过感性众生的认知活动在物质领域显现。这些力量极其危险且不可预测。

为了确保大众安全需要对虚境采取防护措施。在这方面，我们可以提供帮助。
responses.en:
The Shroud can best be described as a dimension of reality that exists beyond ordinary perception. It is composed entirely of harmful 'psionic' energy. It touches every part of our physical galaxy, yet many do not actively perceive it.

The Shroud's energies can manifest in the physical realm through the cognitive activity of sentient beings. These forces are extremely dangerous and unpredictable.

Ensuring your population's safety requires protective measures against the Shroud. To that end, we can provide help.

texts.en:

This is why our rate for its purchase is well above the galactic standard.

What is Zro?

responses.zh:
泽珞是一种高度不稳定的稀有物质，它的具体效用难以控制和预测。无论是有意或是无意，它可能引发剧烈的能量爆炸，造成大规模破坏。

这些性质是通过一种与虚境的反应产生的，这使其在灵能实践者中非常受欢迎——有些人甚至把这东西当成药来磕。

我们希望能进一步研究泽珞，找出安全处置的方法；这也是我们对回购泽珞出手如此阔绰的原因。
responses.en:
Zro is a rare, highly unstable substance, the effects of which are difficult to control and predict. Intentionally or not, it can cause violent bursts of energy that wreak destruction on a mass scale.

These properties are produced through reactions with the Shroud, making it popular among psionic practitioners - some of whom ingest it as a drug.

We aim to learn more about zro and to research methods for its safe disposal; that is why we pay handsomely for any quantity brought to us.

texts.zh:
抑制灵能光环主要有两种方法。

在行星上建造灵能抑制器可以逐渐减少整个恒星系的光环强度，并且防止进一步污染。

更强大的解决方法是虚境封印。这种复杂的机械可以逐渐消解灵能光环，直至完全抑制——生效范围包括其本身以及通过超空间航道直接相连的恒星系。
texts.en:
There are two principal methods of suppressing Psionic Auras.

Building a Psionic Suppressor on a planet will gradually reduce Aura intensity throughout the star system and prevent any further encroachment.

An even more powerful solution is a Shroud Seal. These sophisticated machines will gradually dissipate any Psionic Aura until it is suppressed entirely - in both the host system and those in direct connection via hyperlanes.

我谨代表[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]与你通话。

I speak to you as a representative of the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName].

Judging by our psi-sensor readings, the whole [Root.GetName] has been irremediably infected by the Shroud.

Your actions have spelled your end - and we will hasten it.

texts.en:
Ah, yes. We are aware of their psionic practices. A show of force is justified.

Thank you for your support. The operation will commence shortly.

label.en: What is the Shroud?

responses.zh:
虚境可以说是一种存在于普通感知之外的维度现实。它完全由有害的“灵能”能量组成。它触及我们物质星系的每一个部分，然而多数人无法主动感知到它。

虚境的能量可以通过感性众生的认知活动在物质领域显现。这些力量极其危险且不可预测。

为了确保大众安全需要对虚境采取防护措施。在这方面，我们可以提供帮助。
responses.en:
The Shroud can best be described as a dimension of reality that exists beyond ordinary perception. It is composed entirely of harmful 'psionic' energy. It touches every part of our physical galaxy, yet many do not actively perceive it.

The Shroud's energies can manifest in the physical realm through the cognitive activity of sentient beings. These forces are extremely dangerous and unpredictable.

Ensuring your population's safety requires protective measures against the Shroud. To that end, we can provide help.

label.en: What is the Shroud?

responses.zh:
虚境可以说是一种存在于普通感知之外的维度现实。它完全由有害的“灵能”能量组成。它触及我们物质星系的每一个部分，然而多数人无法主动感知到它。

虚境的能量可以通过感性众生的认知活动在物质领域显现。这些力量极其危险且不可预测。

为了确保大众安全需要对虚境采取防护措施。在这方面，我们可以提供帮助。
responses.en:
The Shroud can best be described as a dimension of reality that exists beyond ordinary perception. It is composed entirely of harmful 'psionic' energy. It touches every part of our physical galaxy, yet many do not actively perceive it.

The Shroud's energies can manifest in the physical realm through the cognitive activity of sentient beings. These forces are extremely dangerous and unpredictable.

Ensuring your population's safety requires protective measures against the Shroud. To that end, we can provide help.

summary.text:
# 灵督城邦 / Mindwarden Enclave

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C6 巨兽与城邦 / Leviathans & enclaves
- 来源 Sources：`events/shroud_events.txt:9235-10840 (shroud.4195-4350)`; `events/shroud_events.txt:10656-10752 (4285/4286/4295)`; `events/shroud_events.txt:10842-11062 (4400-4410)`; `events/shroud_events.txt:14897-15805 (6850-6881)`; `common/solar_system_initializers/mindwarden_initializers.txt:8-150`; `common/scripted_effects/first_contact_effects.txt:702-718`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:744`; `common/scripted_effects/shroud_shadows_scripted_effects.txt:4482-4508`; `events/origin_events_shadows_shroud.txt:3046-3079 (6827)`
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud（星系生成器要求 has_shroud_dlc / initializer requires has_shroud_dlc）
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

灵督城邦是一个太空城邦：拥有“虚境阴影”时，星系生成器 mindwarden_enclave_initializer 会生成它（若有帝国选择灵督起源则不生成，改由该起源建立雇佣城邦，见 origin_events_shadows_shroud.txt 的 shroud.6827）。首次接触完成时（finish_first_contact_effect、leviathans.98 或 on_action_events_1 的城邦分支）触发隐藏事件 shroud.4199，它在你建有物现引擎时额外增加信任，然后进入 4200；此后每次通过外交界面联络城邦，都由 on_custom_diplomacy 直接调用 4200。4200 → 4201 根据当前状态选择一种问候。

The Mindwarden Enclave is a space enclave. With Shadows of the Shroud the galaxy initializer mindwarden_enclave_initializer spawns it (not if any empire took the Mindwardens origin; that origin founds its own mercenary enclaves instead, see shroud.6827 in origin_events_shadows_shroud.txt). Completing first contact (finish_first_contact_effect, leviathans.98 or the enclave branch of on_action_events_1) fires hidden shroud.4199, which adds trust for each Materiality Engine and calls 4200; every later diplomatic contact calls 4200 directly via on_custom_diplomacy. 4200 → 4201 then picks one greeting from the current state.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

这是可重复的通讯枢纽，不是一次性的剧情。4201 的问候互斥：自己创建的雇佣城邦（灵督起源的赞助方）看到 6852（首个城邦）/6853（又一城邦）/6851（回访）；城邦被毁后只剩 4350 的沉默；攻击过城邦的帝国永久只得到 4320 的拒绝；与行虚者城邦信任≥100 得到 4340；突破虚境的帝国得到 4300 的敌意（可追问 4310）；其余帝国进入主菜单 4205。主菜单可询问虚境（对话）、泽珞（4250：可出售至多100泽珞换取高价能量，冷却3600天）、灵能光环（4230：付1000能量+50影响力获得灵能压制科技25%进度）、袭击一个已接触的灵能帝国（4240：5000能量+50影响力，冷却3600天）、犯罪（4260：思想警察决议）、信任≥80时的后勤援助（4265，3600天后 4267 来信续约）、借用士兵（4270：14支灵督突击队）、督管专员（4280：5级领袖，冷却720天）；“轮回之终末”结束后可谈论它并购买对抗最终清算的战术（4290→4292→4291）。各子页的“算了”回到出发时的问候页；“再会”结束通讯。

This is a repeatable communication hub, not a one-time plot. The greetings from 4201 are exclusive: the empire that created this mercenary enclave (Mindwardens origin patron) sees 6852 (first enclave) / 6853 (another enclave) / 6851 (later visits); after the enclave is destroyed only the silence of 4350 remains; an empire that ever attacked it is refused forever (4320); Shroudwalker trust ≥ 100 gives 4340; a Shroud-breached empire gets hostility (4300, follow-up 4310); everyone else gets the menu 4205. Menu topics: the Shroud (dialogue), zro (4250: sell up to 100 zro for premium energy, 3600-day cooldown), psionic auras (4230: 1000 energy + 50 influence for 25% of Psionic Suppression), a raid on a known psionic empire (4240: 5000 energy + 50 influence, 3600-day cooldown), crime (4260: Thought Police decision), and at trust ≥ 80 logistics (4265; 4267 offers renewal after 3600 days), soldiers (4270: 14 Assault Warden armies) and a Commissioner (4280: level-5 leader, 720-day cooldown); after the End of the Cycle it can be discussed and anti-Reckoning tactics bought (4290 → 4292 → 4291). "Never mind" on a sub-page returns to the greeting the conversation started from; "Goodbye" closes it.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

袭击选项把 4246（已建立通讯）或 4247（未接触）发给被袭击的帝国，随后该帝国看到 4300 的敌意问候；付款方只看到 4245。灵督起源的赞助方另有 4205.i → 6855：升级城邦（五档，1000–13000能量）、共享科技（获得1000能量，十年一次）、雇佣舰队十年（6875→6876）、管理合约（6880：延长或终止→6881）、提升城邦容量（6865）。后果：首次与城邦交战（on_entering_battle → 4285）永久设置 attacked_mindwardens、信任-100，若雇有灵督督管专员则五天后专员离开（4286）。城邦空间站被击毁（on_ship_destroyed_victim → 4400）时，攻击方看到 4405（获得2000合金与4000物理研究），其他有通讯的帝国看到 4406；非雇佣城邦会在十年后尝试于无主星系重建一次（4410）。建造物现引擎的帝国（已与城邦通讯）获得信任+5，30天后收到一次 4295。

The raid option sends 4246 (with communications) or 4247 (no contact) to the raided empire, which then sees the hostile greeting 4300; the paying empire only sees 4245. The Mindwardens-origin patron also has 4205.i → 6855: upgrade the enclave (five tiers, 1000–13000 energy), share technology (gain 1000 energy, once per 10 years), hire a fleet for 10 years (6875 → 6876), manage the contract (6880: extend or terminate → 6881) and raise enclave capacity (6865). Consequences: the first battle against the enclave (on_entering_battle → 4285) sets attacked_mindwardens permanently and trust −100; a hired Mindwarden Commissioner leaves 5 days later (4286). When the enclave station is destroyed (on_ship_destroyed_victim → 4400) the attacker sees 4405 (2000 alloys, 4000 physics) and other empires in contact see 4406; a non-mercenary enclave tries once to respawn in an unowned system 10 years later (4410). An empire in contact that builds a Materiality Engine gains +5 trust and gets 4295 once, 30 days later.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

4205.a“虚境是什么”只对非灵督起源开放；4205.c 需已遭遇灵能光环且未掌握灵能压制；4205.d 需有已接触的灵能帝国；ef/f/g 需信任≥80；h 需全局“轮回之终末”已完成；i 只对创建该城邦的赞助方显示。4320/4405/4406 的文本按本国是否灵能化变化。

4205.a "What is the Shroud?" is offered only to non-Mindwarden empires; 4205.c needs encountered psionic auras and no Psionic Suppression yet; 4205.d needs a psionic empire in contact; ef/f/g need trust ≥ 80; h needs the global End of the Cycle completion flag; i is shown only to the patron who created the enclave. 4320/4405/4406 vary their text for psionic empires.
